issues.on_page: Expenditures listed by object (Clerk fees, Electricity, Engineering, Repairs and maintenance...)
issues.issue: The statement lists spending by object only, so the rules require "review": "listed by object" on these lines, and none has it. Electricity in an SID is probably street lighting (streets/highways).

Confirmed this is the report itself and not a misread. Every digit on p6 reads clearly, there is no seventh line, and the printed total is backed up elsewhere: operating loss (102,122) = 208,277 - 310,399; Statement of Activities p2 Water expenses 310,399; ending net position 181,265; cash-flow p7 payments to suppliers 278,586 = 310,399 - 23,683 depreciation - 6,942 sales tax - 1,187 AP increase (+1 rounding). So one or more printed expense lines (or an omitted line) understate by 4,020. Recorded correctly as a report discrepancy. Business-type disbursement lines therefore sum to 306,379, not 310,399.
